_comment: CLIP zero-shot prompt catalogue. Each prompt is a natural-language label scored by the CLIP model; a top-scoring prompt writes (feature, value) into the image feature snapshot for phenotype matching. feature/value pairs are validated against ImageNGP.json at startup. Edit to add or retune prompts without recompiling. A duplicate prompt will overwrite the result of the first prompt.
